scope: Independently assembled public baseline 02e3421e plus this bounded maintainability/security cohort; not the entire local working tree
security_scope: Real owner-authenticated loopback test positive; unauthenticated and merchant rejection; spoofed host/forwarded headers cannot establish a local peer.
Production HTTP API-key rejection is an authentication control only; the independent route-level production guard is tested separately. No claim of a live production OIDC integration.
Configured owner credentials are absent from the positive HTML and response headers; the lab no longer mints a browser owner-key cookie.
limits: Size checks are growth ratchets, not proof that legacy long functions are easy to maintain.
The accumulated historical Ruff checkpoint remains required and has outstanding debt.
The code inventory is mechanical; no blanket semantic approval of every source line.
